---
title: Linguine in Anchovy Sauce
id: MAR-0084
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 280 g spaghetti
- 8 anchovy fillets
- 1 onion
- 40 g butter
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Peel the onion and dice it.
2. Chop the anchovies.
3. Sauté the onion in a pan with the butter for 15 minutes, moistening occasionally with a few tablespoons of water; 5 minutes before the end of cooking, add the anchovies and dissolve them with a wooden spoon.
4. Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water, drain them and pour them into the pan with 3 tablespoons of their cooking water; mix and serve.
